text: This report requests that Toronto and East York Community Council deny the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located at 280 Withrow Avenue. The applicant is seeking permission to remove the tree to address concerns that the tree is in poor condition due to systemic heartwood rot. The subject tree is a silver maple tree (Acer saccharinum) measuring 78.5 cm in diameter. The Tree By-laws do not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Denied the request for a permit to remove a privately owned tree located at 280 Withrow Avenue.
